lines.say: Welcome. Allow yourself to settle into a comfortable, upright position, and gently close your eyes.
Take a slow, deep breath in, all the way down, and let it go completely.
With each breath out, let your body grow heavier, softer, and more at ease.
There is nowhere to go, and nothing to do. Simply allow this moment to be exactly as it is.
Let your attention rest on the gentle pulse of sound, quietly drawing you inward.
If a thought arises, notice it kindly, and let it drift away like a passing cloud.
Sinking deeper now, with every breath. Calm, and still.
Rest here, in this quiet, open space. There is nothing you need to hold on to.
Simply being. Aware, and at peace.
Whenever you are ready, allow yourself to settle even deeper into the stillness.
In a few moments, we will gently begin to return.
Slowly allow your awareness to expand outward, back to the space around you.
Begin to feel your body, your hands, and the rhythm of your breath.
Take a deeper breath, and when you are ready, softly open your eyes, carrying this calm with you.
